verified_modalities_note: No observed (recorded) patient SEEG/EEG, no imaging volumes, no electrode coordinates, no posterior samples. Signal values are in model units (not uV; units not stated). time_steps unit not stated in files; inferred ms from the TVB monitor period (10 ms) in the simulation notebooks: step 10 for P1 SEEG/TI-SEEG and P2 TI files, 8 for P2 SEEG-stim files, P1_TI_EEG uses integer sample indices.
evidence_kind_of_contents: simulated_result. The time series are outputs of the authors' high-resolution TVB neural-field Epileptor-Stimulation simulations of stimulation-induced seizures, projected to sensors; notebooks stimulation_plot_time_series_P1_TI.ipynb and stimulation_plot_time_series_sensor_P2_EEG.ipynb describe them as the simulated data for Patient 1 / Patient 2. They are the INPUT observations to the Bayesian inversion, NOT fitted estimates and NOT observed clinical recordings or outcomes. SC and gain are processed, patient-derived structural inputs.
intervention_linkage: Stimulation modality modelled only: SEEG bipolar pulse-train stimulation (Sim_SEEG_nf.ipynb example 50 Hz, 3 mA) and temporal-interference stimulation (Sim_TI_nf.ipynb, TI envelope from SimNIBS fields, example I=0.3). Purpose: EZN estimation from stimulation-induced seizures. No therapeutic stimulation outcome; no patient outcome linkage.
eligibility: reproduction benchmark for R3 model qualification; not a validation cohort

reference_outputs_available: No numeric posterior samples or x0 estimates in the repo (notebook says HMC output is ~32 GB; sampling cells are commented out). Only PNG posterior plots embedded in notebook outputs (run_samplings_mcmc.ipynb cells 36/40, run_samplings-mm_inference.ipynb, plot_posterior_xv.ipynb) and the paper's figures. The ground-truth x0/EZ used to generate each file is not stored in the npz (example notebooks set EZ='Left-F1-lateral-prefrontal', x0 -2.2/-2.3, in a generic subject dir; per-file mapping not verified).
limitations: Simulated sensor data, not observed patient recordings; cannot validate clinical EZ or outcomes.
n=2, same patients as the paper (one study family).

Signal units and sampling metadata not stated in files.
